fields.Name: T264 - Vectors AI Suggest Document Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the AI entity-document suggestion flow (OpenSuggestDialog/RunSuggestion) with its entity picker and use-case selection — a distinct AI-authoring dialog separate from the sync table and edit panel.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub 'Vectors' screen (via application switcher then Vectors), click the 'Suggest Document' button in the Entity Sync Status panel header. Success is that an 'AI Document Suggestion' slide-in panel opens with an entity picker (searchable dropdown) and a use-case selector (Duplicate Detection / Search / Classification), plus a 'Generate Template' button. Pick an entity and choose a use case; you may click Generate to confirm it enters a 'Generating with AI…' state, but you do NOT need to wait for or save the result. Confirm the panel renders its controls and can be closed. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Suggest Document' opens an AI Document Suggestion panel with an entity picker and use-case options
Selecting an entity/use-case and (optionally) clicking Generate produces a generating state or a suggested-template result; the panel can be closed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
